objective: Từ một simple contextual question, xác định quantities/conditions, chọn một representation toán phù hợp, reason/calculate trong representation đó và diễn giải answer trở lại context với assumptions được nêu.

external_curriculum_mappings.phase: KS1-KS4 problem solving and mathematical modelling contexts
K-12 Mathematical Practice: model with mathematics and reason quantitatively
F-10 mathematical modelling and problem solving
Primary-Secondary mathematical problem solving as central process
Educação Básica problem situations, representations and modelling

misconceptions_or_representation_notes: A model is a purpose-built mathematical representation, not the context itself.
Choosing an equation is one possible representation; tables, diagrams or graphs may be more appropriate in other problems.
Finishing a calculation does not finish the modelling cycle until the result is interpreted in context.

objective: Kiểm tra và cải thiện một simple mathematical model bằng units, sign/bounds, order of magnitude, stated constraints và context; nếu representation/result không hợp lý, revise assumptions, representation hoặc calculation và giải thích lý do.

K-12 Mathematical Practice: model, reason quantitatively, attend to precision
F-10 modelling cycle, reasoning and validation

Fundamental-Ensino Médio contextual problem solving and representations

misconceptions_or_representation_notes: A numerically precise result can still be contextually impossible.
Reasonableness checks can reveal an error but do not prove empirical truth.
Revising a model is part of mathematical problem solving, not evidence that modelling failed.
